articles.title: Simone Donnelly, 73, Longtime Volunteer
articles.deck: Friends remember Simone Donnelly for the many years of service to Lower Millrace.
body: Survivors include a daughter, two grandchildren and many friends from Lower Millrace.
Simone Donnelly died in September at home on Salem Drive, at the age of 73.

Services will be held at the parish hall, and donations may be made to Scout Troop 14 in his or her name. Born in Lower Millrace in the years after the war, Simone Donnelly spent most of a working life in the trades and most of a retirement in the neighborhood.

articles.title: Letters: Eastgate Avenue Parking Is Out of Control
body: To the editor: I have lived on Eastgate Avenue for 10 years, and I want to say what a difference the Bellwood Chapel has made.
Thank you for printing this letter, and for all the work the paper does to keep us informed.
Please keep the summer concert series in the budget. Many of us on Eastgate Avenue use it every week. I hope the council will listen to the people who turned out at the November meeting.
Arthur Wallace, Eastgate

articles.title: Council Splits 4–3 on Bike Repair Clinic
articles.deck: The vote came after 21 residents spoke at Saturday’s session.
